scope: Training-only mechanistic diagnostic; no weight edits, candidate selection, validation scoring or final access
question: Do positive products from two negative factors in previously selected final-MLP channels materially affect category decisions?
selection: All 138 frozen training records, existing order. Channel union from the already evaluated contrast-0.01 and error-ablation-2 patches; no new channel search.
arms: zero only selected final-token MLP products whose effective gate and value are both negative
budget: At most278 full forwards: 2 authored synthetic baseline/sham checks plus 2 per training example. Same total compute/storage budget and 2026-11-03T05:45Z deadline. No editor calls.
capture: Final MLP effective gate, value and product separately at last token. Aggregate all four sign regimes, counts and absolute activation mass over selected channels, plus per-channel counts. Private row arrays and IDs remain remote.
statistics: Paired training wrong-to-correct/correct-to-wrong counts, prediction changes and true-class margin delta p10/p50/p90; fraction of activation mass in each regime; no success threshold and no generalization claim.
guards: Gate-times-value exactly reproduces BF16 down-projection input; sham preserves logits; frozen training and patch hashes; original training predictions agree at replay; hooks removed after every arm and on failure; no checkpoint writes.
failure: One output generation, retain error and completed count, no automatic retry. Diagnosis may be null or harmful. Do not promote global double-negative ablation from this local probe.
